selection_rule: Maximum dev MRR@5, tie priority keyword, vector, hybrid. Persist selection before first test query.
candidate_corpus: All ten documents in both splits. Searches scoped to their uploaded IDs.
parameters: Existing deployed chunking and retrieval settings frozen; no parameter sweep. Compare the three modes on development, report all three test modes descriptively.
annotation: Agent-authored without retrieval results; 50 answerable facts and 10 negatives. Not independently human-adjudicated. Exact-quote alternatives within each source document; judgments are not exhaustive.
constraints: No retrieval/threshold/prompt changes after held-out inspection.
Negative nonempty search results are not hallucinations; answer-level evaluation is separate.
This is a small single-domain benchmark, not an accuracy or latency guarantee.
Known publications may occur in model training; test split is held out only from development mode selection.
